content.short: Galaxia Studios focuses on fully on-chain, open-source game development and making complex tech accessible to everyday users.
content.description: Galaxia Studios develops Web3 and blockchain games with a strong emphasis on entirely on-chain applications, open-source development, and user-friendly design. The studio creates fun, innovative experiences that run fully on-chain, while removing complexity for everyday players. By championing openness, collaboration, and accessible tooling, Galaxia Studios aims to make decentralized gaming and applications approachable, reliable, and genuinely enjoyable for a broad audience across Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Harmony, and Avalanche.
content.meta: Galaxia Studios is a global leader in Web3 and blockchain game development. Discover Galaxia Studios and other Web3 Gaming Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
